# Output — reduced Klein--Nishina

Classification: consistency test of asymptotic reduction.

Normalization:

$$
\frac{d\sigma}{d\Omega}
=
\frac{r_e^2}{2}
\left(\frac{E'}{E}\right)^2
\left(\frac{E'}{E}+\frac{E}{E'}-\sin^2\theta\right).
$$
